newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore fuel oil trades at five-year high.
newsitem.headline: Singapore fuel oil trades at five-year high.

text.p: A 20,000 tonne cargo of 180-centistoke fuel oil was traded on Wednesday at $124.00 per tonne, the highest level since the 1991 Gulf war, traders said.
The October 24-28 cargo was confirmed sold by Royal/Dutch Shell to Singapore trader Sanko Oil, traders said.
The latest deal topped the previous five-year high of $123.50 traded in January. The 20,000 tonne cargo was acquired by Sanko oil.
Traders said fuel oil prices in Singapore are rallying amid a worldwide rise in crude oil and product prices.
